_about: The game worlds the journal travels to. An article picks one with a top-level "world": "<key>" field in its post data (empty = the TZERØ hub). Colours and scenes live in assets/css/worlds.css and assets/js/scene.js under the same key; names, codes and fonts live here. "hidden": true keeps a world off the menus (the editor greys it out). No character art anywhere: worlds are drawn with colour, type and scenery only.

tzero.name: TZERØ
tzero.tagline: Where every trip starts and ends: studio notes, news and the journal itself.

starchasers.name: Starchasers
starchasers.tagline: A starship called Contrary, a route of small planets, a crew that's being redrawn.
